title: Law to set inspection rules for CityFHEPS apartments
summary: This bill would require the Department of Social Services to inspect apartments in person before approving CityFHEPS rental assistance for them. It would require the agency to create a checklist labeling conditions as major or minor, and owners with no more than 4 unsatisfactory minor conditions could fix them by submitting proof through a new online portal instead of a follow-up inspection. The agency could also allow newly built units to skip inspection entirely, and the law would take effect 180 days after passage.
